tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The ground. Void is the primary theme — the product lives in a terminal and a dark PR page.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the attestation. One step off the ground, never more.

tokens.name: bg-sunk
tokens.usage: Terminal panes and code fields. True black in Void — the output is the hero.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body. 16.8:1 in Void, 18.1:1 in Paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, counts, abstain reasons, every second line. 5.9:1 in Void, 6.4:1 in Paper.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled only. Never a sentence that must be read.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every border and divider in the product. The system has one hairline.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Under a section heading, and the left rule of an attestation.

tokens.name: proof
tokens.usage: The brand, and EQUIVALENT. The only colour the system owns. Logo, links, primary action, proven verdict — all the same green, on purpose.

tokens.name: proof-dim
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states, and the tint behind a signed attestation.

tokens.name: break
tokens.usage: DIVERGED, and nothing else. Never a brand surface, never a button.

tokens.name: open
tokens.usage: ABSTAINED. A neutral on purpose — abstaining is an answer, not a fault.

tokens.name: proof-press
tokens.usage: The pressed state of a proof surface. Never used as a text colour.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring only, 2px at 2px offset. The one colour that is neither brand nor verdict, so interaction is never mistaken for a result.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page. Headline moments only — the wordmark itself is drawn, not set.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The big line on a marketing surface.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Section openers and the attestation title.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: First paragraph of a page. One per page.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, help text, second lines.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and column headings. Weight carries hierarchy; size stays put.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The only uppercase style. Capitals set in the markup, never with text-transform.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The input count — the number read before any word.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: CLI output, code, hashes, inputs and outputs.

styles.name: verdict
styles.usage: Three strings in the whole product. That is the entire job of this style.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The unit. Glyph-to-word inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell and chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above a display line.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Tables, rules, documents — QED is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inputs and chips.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, the terminal pane. The ceiling for any rectangle.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The mark's three intact corners, as a fraction of its side — so the curve scales with the logo instead of flattening at display size. Below 24px it goes to 0.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The verdict dot. The only round object in the system.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Every border. The system has one weight.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: The attestation's left rule and the focus ring. Nothing else.
